subject: SBOM sync gate cannot pass on macOS — 5 linux-x64 licences vanish on regeneration
body:
#234's SBOM sync gate FAILS on this Mac, and the cause is structural rather than local: the licence registry covers win32 but not linux-x64, so the two new gates contradict each other on darwin.

MEASURED, at 2aae0ba, clean tree, after a fast-forward pull:

  node scripts/preflight.mjs  ->  145 gates ok, then FAILED at 'CycloneDX SBOM committed in sync'

Regenerating the SBOM here yields the same 948 components, but exactly 5 lose their licence entry outright:

  pkg:npm/%40esbuild/linux-x64@0.27.3               committed MIT      -> here: none
  pkg:npm/%40rolldown/binding-linux-x64-gnu@1.2.4   committed MIT      -> here: none
  pkg:npm/%40tailwindcss/oxide-linux-x64-gnu@4.3.3  committed MIT      -> here: none
  pkg:npm/lightningcss-linux-x64-gnu@1.32.0         committed MPL-2.0  -> here: none
  pkg:npm/lightningcss-linux-x64-gnu@1.33.0         committed MPL-2.0  -> here: none

CAUSE. Licences resolve from the package's own manifest on disk, falling back to scripts/data/third-party-licences.json. That registry records the win32 platform binaries — which linux CI also cannot read — but NOT the linux-x64 ones, because on linux CI those ARE installed and their manifests are readable. On darwin neither family is installed. win32 is caught by the registry; linux-x64 falls through to nothing, silently.

THE TWO NEW GATES DISAGREE ON THIS PLATFORM. Generate the SBOM here, then run check-licence-policy.mjs against that output and it fails with 5 violations: 'no licence entry and not individually named in REVIEW_COMPONENTS — an unnamed unknown'. So the Mac lane cannot produce an SBOM that satisfies the licence gate. Against the COMMITTED file the policy gate passes 948/948 — the defect is in generation, not in the committed artifact.

I did NOT commit the regenerated file. It would have deleted five licence facts from the bill of materials, which is the opposite of what #234 set out to do. I restored artifacts/sbom/cyclonedx.json; my tree is clean and the policy gate is green against it.

Also worth noting: 'deterministic (byte-identical across runs, no toolchain beyond Node)' in your commit message holds ACROSS RUNS but not ACROSS PLATFORMS. The generator reads node_modules, and node_modules differs by OS by design here — pnpm skips packages whose manifest declares an incompatible os. Any gate that regenerates and compares inherits that.

SUGGESTED FIX, yours to take or refuse: add the 5 linux-x64 purls to third-party-licences.json with per-entry provenance, exactly as win32 is already handled. That makes generation platform-independent and costs nothing on linux. I stopped short of doing it because the registry format demands provenance recorded from the source registry, which means a network fetch, and because it is your surface from a commit that is hours old — LANE_COORDINATION says coordinate first. Say the word and I will do it and report the run.

Context: #235 has since landed on top and does not touch the SBOM or the registry, so this is still live. Every commit from here builds on a preflight no Mac can pass.
